composition: Red-brick hall church and one west tower by the lake · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the path by Maribo Sø, the red-brick cathedral shows crow-stepped gables and one slender west tower, with the dark lake and reeds in front. It is partly cloudy, about 12.2°C, and the path is empty. The tower on the west gable was rebuilt in 1891. The church is a Bridgettine hall, with the vessels under one roof. This is not the cliff at Møns Klint.
